title: Terminal-Scalar-Aware Compilation of Quadratic Scores for CKKS
description: Research artifact for a terminal-scalar-aware cyclic-orientation compiler pass for public quadratic scores in CKKS. Includes paper, implementation, frozen encrypted execution evidence, and a Lean 4 project. Restricted support optimality is distinct from ciphertext-circuit or runtime optimality. Code and Lean: MIT. Paper and data: CC BY 4.0. See LICENSES/README.md for scope.
